integrity: A mathematical all-parameter extension proof establishes the infinite part. Exhaustive finite-type and pair-pattern programs independently corroborate finite instances only; they do not certify the infinite theorem. Source dates are those of supporting prior literature, not a publication date for this result.
limitations: Classification is only for quantifier rank three, pure equality/undirected adjacency, complete finite branching trees of branching at least two; higher ranks, named roots, child directions, ancestry and arbitrary trees are not classified. Historical priority is not exhaustively established.
title: Six three-round theories of finite complete branching trees in pure adjacency
